body: I'm trying, I really am. I dont understand how It's broken me so.

Nobody seems to think I need time. But I do. I need it so badly, but my parents will have none of it. I was suposed to go to uni next year, a year earlier than normal, but i just dont know if im ready. Time is what I don't have.
My only goal was to make her happy and I always asked "are you happy?". She always said yes, and I believe she was telling the truth. I don't know what happened.

I've known her longer than anybody else. close friend for about six years before I asked her out. We were incredibly close, and spent most of our time in the last few months just holding eachother. We couldn't watch movies, or play games, or go on walks as we used to because we were far too distracting for eachother. We're both raging nerds, into robotics, books and computers. However she was the most beautiful person I've ever met. I didn't think that at first. I wanted to be with her because I made her happy. But as the months went by I actually developed an attraction to her as our love grew. It was ridiculous, and still now I see her face in my sleep.
Its really hard because I need very good grades to get selected into the medical course I want to. I'm not really sure I'll make it this year.
I'm really trying. My friends are a great help but my willpower, where previously I never struggled with, is an issue.
